notes: Standard VAT 20% (PwC Armenia); no investment-gold exemption, so bullion and jewellery pay 20%. ArmSwissBank offers, 21 Nov 2026, vs its XAU offer AMD 41,477/g: 5 g bar AMD 263,800 (+27.2%), 10 g 523,900 (+26.3%), 20 g 1,041,400 (+25.5%), 50 g 2,540,300 (+22.5%), 100 g 4,973,300 (+19.9%); bar asks appear VAT-inclusive. No published bar bid, so buyback null; EEU gold duty not stated, so null.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Armenia, Corporate - Other taxes
sources.what: The standard rate of VAT is 20%; exported goods/services are zero-rated and most financial and education services are exempt - no investment-gold exemption is stated. Customs are under the EEU common tariff with no gold-specific duty rate given.

sources.name: ArmSwissBank - Armenian Financial Market (bank quotes)
sources.what: Bank's published quotes timestamped 21.11.2026: gold bar OFFER prices - 5 g AMD 263,800; 10 g AMD 523,900; 20 g AMD 1,041,400; 50 g AMD 2,540,300; 100 g AMD 4,973,300 - and XAU (gold) non-cash BID AMD 40,429 / OFFER AMD 41,477 per gram on the same page. Premiums = bar offer per gram / XAU offer per gram - 1. No bar bid is published.
